items.name: narration_hi
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy 'what if' geography Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel, in natural spoken Hindi like a top Indian geography explainer channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who can't believe how cool this story is and can't wait to tell you. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright and punchy, loud-ish and lively. Wide, dramatic pitch movement: rise with real wonder on every question, hit every number with genuine amazement ('WOW' energy), build excitement through each line, and land each punchline with a grin after a tiny comic pause. 'Twist ये है' gets a playful, knowing, excited lift. 'लेकिन ये अभी सबसे अजीब बात नहीं है' is whispered-excited, leaning in like a secret. 'वो कभी नहीं बना।' is delivered slowly and dryly, like a punchline, after a tiny pause. 'बढ़कर आठ हो गया।' lands as its own proud beat. Numbers and English words (place names, constitution, goal, Federation, million, U.S.A., seventh, lake, oceans, coast, try, leaders, federation, union, passport, anthem, parliament, capital, twist) are spoken in English, naturally, the way Indian creators mix them. The last line trails off unfinished on 'क्योंकि सच बताऊं...', voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Pace is quick and bouncy with short crisp pauses; never slow, flat, calm, sleepy, bored or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy level throughout. Say U.S.A. as the three letters U-S-A. Pronounce 'Arusha' as 'ah-ROO-shah', 'Kinshasa' as 'kin-SHAH-sah', 'Nairobi' as 'nye-ROH-bee'. Read ONLY the text provided, word for word, every line in order; never add words of your own.
lines: Narrator
अगर East Africa... एक देश बन जाए?
Narrator
Twist ये है: इसका constitution अभी लिखा जा रहा है।
Narrator
आठ देश, Congo से... Somalia तक।
Narrator
एक ही goal: East African Federation.
Narrator
तो इस देश को क्या मिलेगा?
Narrator
Three hundred thirty million से ज़्यादा लोग... लगभग उतने जितने U.S.A. में।
Narrator
दुनिया का seventh सबसे बड़ा देश: India से भी बड़ा।
Narrator
Africa का सबसे ऊंचा पहाड़... सबसे बड़ी lake... और दो oceans पर coast।
Narrator
और ये पहले भी try हुआ। Nineteen sixty-three में, तीन leaders ने वादा किया एक federation का...
Narrator
उसी साल के अंदर। वो कभी नहीं बना।
Narrator
इनका पहला union nineteen seventy-seven में टूट गया।
Narrator
Two thousand में ये वापस आया... और तीन देशों से बढ़कर आठ हो गया।
Narrator
लेकिन ये अभी सबसे अजीब बात नहीं है।
Narrator
पहले से मौजूद है एक East African passport... एक anthem... और एक parliament.
Narrator
और capital? शायद Arusha, Tanzania में।
Narrator
Nairobi नहीं। Kinshasa भी नहीं, जो सबसे बड़ा शहर है।
Narrator
और Arusha बस एक बात कहता है।
Narrator
तो... एक East Africa या आठ देश? क्योंकि सच बताऊं...
